basis: Every paper setup that has finished: stopped, sold at its last target, exited on the clock, lapsed unfilled or cancelled. Kept permanently, none removed. Fills are simulated on daily bars; no order was placed. The result is net of estimated charges, in R of the risk at the fill. Where one bar reached both a target and the stop, the stop is booked first.
